The next slice gives ratio R(n)=h1/h0=alpha omega^(un)+beta omega^(vn); the telescoping product for j shifts factors into q-Pochhammer partial product with q=omega^(-s(c-b)) order d and z=omega^((c-b)n), z^d=1. The cyclotomic full-d block equals 1-(-t)^d and is nonzero because all window ratios are nonzero. For r<d, Gaussian q-binomial coefficient factors (1-q^h) have h<d and are nonzero, and distinct z^0..z^r frequencies cannot collide. Multiplicative character pre-factor shifts frequencies only. Summing N/d complete repetitions gives N(d+1)/2. Existence: alpha=(1+(-0.7)^d)^(1/d)>0.7, beta=0.7, R(n)=alpha+beta omega^(Nn/d), whose cyclic product is 1; nonvanishing then gives consistent nonzero g and f=1/conj(g). This algebra is valid for every composite N, not numerical FFT threshold extrapolation.
